course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Summarize another viewpoint and respond with partial agreement or disagreement.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Reacting to a short comment about digital dependence, prices, media, or daily habits.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Showing understanding of a viewpoint before giving a careful response.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a short comment claiming that people depend too much on digital services in everyday life.

main_focus.name: reported viewpoint plus response with håller delvis med
main_focus.description: Use source/reporting language to summarize a viewpoint, then respond with partial agreement or polite disagreement.
model_examples: Kommentaren säger att digitala tjänster sparar tid.
Jag håller delvis med, men det blir svårt när systemen inte fungerar.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2-3 summary/reporting phrases and 2-3 response phrases for agreement, partial agreement, or disagreement.

allowed_supporting_grammar: subordinate clauses with när or om

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use response chunks that help the learner sound thoughtful rather than blunt.

dialogue_shape.opening: A short viewpoint or comment is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the viewpoint, identify its main point, and respond with partial agreement or disagreement.
dialogue_shape.ending: They form a balanced response with one reason or example.

target_complexity.repetition: The dialogue can include source framing but should remain an accessible everyday discussion.

focus: the main point of the viewpoint being summarized
the contrast between agreement and concern in the response
the reason or example used to support the response

sentence_focus: one sentence summarizing a viewpoint with säger att
one sentence with poängen är att
one sentence with jag håller delvis med
one sentence adding a contrast with samtidigt or men
one sentence giving a supporting example
